thread:
tara_pm: FYI — Acme has a private deployment request: meridian-8.5b. They need sub-150ms p50 for short-chat (<=128 tokens) and want a cost-optimized quantized path. Asking for a quick sanity sweep before we commit capacity.
andre_ml: Do we have any pretrained artifacts or tokenizers from them? Also what's target load QPS?
rico_infra: Not yet. Acme said they'd push a model artifact (hf repo)  — they emphasized A100/40G-equivalent on-prem. QPS target is spiky: 30-60 rps sustained but bursts to 200 for short windows.
maya_research: For 8.5b on that hardware we should aim for INT8 (AWQ/GGUF) first. We need baseline FP16 perf to compare. Quick checklist: tokenization parity, generation fuzz tests, flash-attn compatibility, kv-cache memory, and prompt prep cost.
sam_oncall: I can run a smoke bench on a dev node today. Need the model link or a sample weights tarball. Also confirm concurrency targets and sequence lengths.
tara_pm: I'll ask Acme for the HF link and a sample prompt set (their chat flows). Also ask permission to run evals on Dedicated dev pool.
and re_ml: For evals, add these to the smoke suite: MMLU-tailored subset (10q), SuperGLUE mini, and 200-pair instruction fidelity set from their prod prompts. We'll track EM/acc and a simple KL-based ngram drift metric.
maya_research: Suggested quant experiments:
```
1) FP16 baseline (no quant, batched inference)
2) PTQ int8 dynamic per-layer (fast)
3) AWQ 4/8-group as available (best quality/cost trade)
4) LLM.int8() path if we need memory-only speedups
```
Include a logits-level alignment check vs FP16. If AWQ is ~<2% task regression on fidelity set, we consider it good.
rico_infra: Memory budget note: meridian-8.5b FP16 ~32GB GPU for single replica with 1x kv-cache for 1024. If they want multi-replica or headroom for bursts, we'll need >2x memory or use quant. Also need to test optimized kernels (cutlass/cublasLt) — could affect p95.
sam_oncall: Kicking off quick script now. Command I'm using:
```
./run_smoke.sh --model meridian-8.5b --profile fp16 --seq 128 --batch 1 --out /tmp/meridian_smoke_fp16.log
```
Will post numbers in ~20m.
ci-bot: deploybot: scheduled job started: smoke-bench-meridian-2410001111 on dev-gpu-03
andre_ml: blockers to watch for: tokenizer mismatches (prefix tokens), BOS/EOS handling, and any special-only layers (MixtureOfExperts etc). If model has custom ops, ping eng-runtime early.
tara_pm: Acme replied with hf link: https://huggingface.co/acme/meridian-8.5b-v1 and sample prompts attached. They allowed perf testing.
maya_research: I'll pull the repo and run the tokenization parity test: tokenization_stats.py --model-path ./meridian --prompts sample_prompts.json
rico_infra: If tokenization differs, we might need to patch tokenizer or add a wrapper. That can add ~8-12ms overhead per request, so call it out in SLO.
sam_oncall: FP16 smoke numbers: p50=132ms, p95=210ms (seq=128, batch=1). Throughput baseline ~45 rps single-threaded. Logs: /tmp/meridian_smoke_fp16.log
andre_ml: Good baseline. Next run int8 PTQ and AWQ. Keep seed and prompt set identical.
ci-bot: deploybot: job completed: smoke-bench-meridian-2410001111 (rc=0)
maya_research: PTQ int8 run: p50=88ms, p95=145ms, fidelity regression on instruction set = 3.8% (EM drop). AWQ-8 group run: p50=95ms, p95=160ms, fidelity regression = 1.2%. AWQ looks promising.
tara_pm: Acme needs guidance on SLA vs cost. Can we prepare a short doc with options (FP16 high cost/high-quality, AWQ mid, PTQ cheap but riskier)?
rico_infra: Yes. Also include recommended runtime knobs: 1) batch target 2) KV-cache warmup 3) soft-prewarming policy for bursts 4) fallback to smaller variant if overloaded.
and re_ml: Action items:
- maya: produce a one-page quality table (FP16 / PTQ / AWQ) with p50/p95 and fidelity deltas.
- sam: run 95th-percentile stress with bursts (200 rps) using AWQ config and report OOMs/queue latencies.
- rico: cost estimate for Dedicated node sizing and autoscale buffer.
- tara: confirm Acme's regulatory constraints (no logs retained? KMS?)
- I'll draft a canary rollout plan for 2% -> 10% -> 100% traffic with rollback triggers.

maya_research: Will have the table by EOD.
sam_oncall: Starting stress run now, will reply in thread with CSV of latencies.
tara_pm: thanks team. tagging @andre_ml @maya_research for prioritization.
and re_ml: Thumbs up. If AWQ holds on the fidelity set and stress test passes, this could be a quick Dedicated onboarding.
rico_infra: Noted. I'll reserve a warm standby node in the dev pool so we can iterate safely.
sam_oncall: Stress run results: AWQ stress at bursts=200 rps -> p95 tail spikes to 480ms due to queuing; no OOMs. With 2 replica warm pool p95 drops to 170ms. CSV: /tmp/meridian_awq_stress.csv
andre_ml: That's actionable. Recommend initial config: AWQ-8, 2x replicas with pre-warm, canary 2% traffic, fidelity monitor with rolling window 1h.
tara_pm: I'll send Acme a summary + pricing options and schedule a 30m walk-through with them tomorrow.
maya_research: Also attaching quick notes on known failure modes (tokenization edge cases, rare token biases) — will send as gist.
ci-bot: reminder: please attach eval artifacts to the onboarding ticket: ONB-4591
andre_ml: Awesome, closing loop here. Reopen thread if Acme pushes a new model variant.
